instruction: I have the academicpages template set up in ~/Code/Website. I need to configure multiple social media profiles in the _config.yml file. Please update the LinkedIn username to "john-smith-researcher" and the ORCID ID to "0000-0001-2345-6789" in the author section.

Evaluator uses check_json with is_yaml=true to verify both fields under author section match expected values. Verified fields exist in YAML structure at lines 60 and 38.
